start.title: The Crown Is Heavy
start.text:
The throne of David is yours.
The kingdom waits for your first word.

choices.feedback: A king's pride blinds his sight.
Wealth is not what God seeks.
Begin every reign with God.

boast_consequence.title: Lay Down Your Pride
boast_consequence.text:
Greatness is given, not taken.
Kneel before the One who gives.

choices.feedback: You set out at first light.

gold_consequence.title: Not by Treasure
gold_consequence.text:
A throne built on greed will crack.
Seek God before all else.

choices.feedback: You leave the treasury behind.

gibeon.title: The High Place
gibeon.text:
A thousand offerings rise from the altar.
The sky burns soft and gold.

choices.feedback: The Lord receives a quiet flame.

choices.text: Offer to be seen by men
choices.feedback: Worship is not for crowds.

seen_consequence.title: For God Alone
seen_consequence.text:
The altar is not a stage.
Give what only the Lord will see.

choices.feedback: Your voice softens to a whisper.

dream.title: Ask What I Shall Give
dream.text:
In sleep, a voice fills the sky.
"Ask what I shall give you."

choices.feedback: Riches will not lead a people.
Power without wisdom destroys.
Wisdom is the greatest gift.

riches_consequence.title: Choose Higher
riches_consequence.text:
Gold cannot judge between right and wrong.
Ask for something greater.

choices.feedback: Your voice trembles with humility.

enemies_consequence.title: Lay Down the Sword
enemies_consequence.text:
Long life and victory pass away.
Ask for what endures.

choices.feedback: You bow lower in the dream.

granted.title: Wisdom and More
granted.text:
"Because you asked this, I give it.
And riches and honor also."

choices.feedback: Wisdom kept in pride is lost.
True wisdom acts in love.

boast2_consequence.title: Walk in Humility
boast2_consequence.text:
A wise heart speaks little of itself.
Return quietly to your throne.

choices.feedback: Dawn finds you ready.

judgment.title: Two Mothers, One Child
judgment.text:
Two women claim the same living child.
The court watches in silence.

choices.feedback: Truth is not measured in volume.
Wisdom asks deeper questions.
True love will reveal itself.

loud_consequence.title: Listen Beneath the Words
loud_consequence.text:
Anger and grief sound the same.
Look for the heart of a mother.

choices.feedback: You raise your sword as a test.

lots_consequence.title: A King Must Discern
lots_consequence.text:
Chance does not bring justice.
Let wisdom find the truth.

choices.feedback: You frame your test with care.

kingdom.title: All Israel Hears
kingdom.text:
The true mother begs to spare the child.
The land marvels at the wisdom of God.
